hints.content:
First, find the amount of the discount by multiplying the original price of the item by the discount.

 $\blue{\$72} \times \green{30\%} = \text{?}$

Percent means "out of one hundred," so $\green{30\%}$ is equivalent to $\green{\dfrac{30}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\green{30 \div 100}$.

 $\green{30 \div 100 = 0.30}$

To find the amount of money saved, multiply $\green{0.30}$ by the original price.

 $\green{0.30} \times \blue{\$72} = \purple{\$21.60}$

To find the final price Gabriela paid, subtract $\purple{\$21.60}$ from the original price.

 $\blue{\$72} - \purple{\$21.60} = \$50.40$

question.content:
Gabriela bought a new pair of glasses at the store when they were having a $30\%$ off sale.

**If the regular price of the pair of glasses was $\$72$, how much did Gabriela pay with the discount?**

$\$\ $[[☃ numeric-input 1]]
